scope: Exact current discovered graph only; additions/changed bytes require delta audit. Not source/code/native acceptance or strict fresh Gradle home execution.

importedMetadata.semanticPairEncoding: UTF-8 JSON compact separators, ensure_ascii=true; sorted [group,module,version,file,sha256] rows

limitations.authenticated_publisher_signatures: Zero verified; signatures disabled in discovered XML, no independently trusted signing fingerprints established.
limitations.verified_publisher_sha256: Independently retrieved official repository published SHA256 (sidecar/module); not an authenticated publisher signature or independent administrative channel.
limitations.verified_retrieved_original_sha256_only: Weaker still: same official repository original bytes only; no usable published strong/weak digest.
limitations.verified_sha1_and_retrieved_original_sha: Weaker: published SHA1 plus independently streamed original SHA256; SHA1 is not strong collision-resistant evidence.
